answer: Give every key a unique work packet derived from its address and the epoch seed, so two accounts never solve the same item and a clone farm must pay full compute for each alias. Packets are accepted only at a single-file admission jetty that rate-limits by funding cluster, not by wallet count. Raw solutions go on a public mirror, where near-duplicate embeddings across different packets still fuse those keys into one voting seat. Each epoch the fused graph is written to a basalt commitment that later arrivals cannot rewrite.
